title: What Did Christa Pike Do? What to Know About the Botched Tennessee Execution.
summary: Ms. Pike, 50, survived two doses of a lethal injection in Tennessee. She was sentenced to death for the 1995 murder of a classmate.

title: How Did Christa Pike Survive Two Lethal Injections of Pentobarbital?
summary: A catheter carrying the drug may not have delivered the doses to Ms. Pike’s bloodstream, experts said. The drug itself may have been degraded.

title: Statement Written by Police in Cornell Assault Case Omitted Her Claim She Was Raped
summary: Documents obtained by The New York Times show that the campus police at Cornell University sent a condensed statement to a prosecutor, who then declined to bring charges.

title: Chi Phi Members Accused in Cornell Sex Assault Lawsuit Give Varying Accounts of Night
summary: Their accounts, detailed in hundreds of pages of investigative files obtained by The New York Times, were disjointed and sometimes contradictory. All the men denied any wrongdoing.

title: As Mortgage Rates Hit Highest Level Since 2023, Buyers Look at ARMs
summary: The average 30-year, fixed-rate home loan rose to 7.28 percent, up from 6.34 percent a year ago. More buyers are now turning to adjustable-rate mortgages.

title: U.S. Bond Yields Hit Highest Level Since 2002
summary: The higher yields, which are pressuring consumer and corporate borrowers and increasingly weighing on certain corners of the stock market, are unlikely to dissipate soon.

title: Trump’s Threat to Ban Diesel Exports Sets Off Global Alarms
summary: A reduction in refineries has already driven the price of diesel to record highs, threatening economies. An U.S. export ban would be “tremendous shock and blow.”

title: Investigators Seek Motive for FlyDubai Cockpit Attack
summary: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of Israel said the co-pilot who set upon the pilot had undergone “Islamist radical indoctrination” but did not elaborate.

title: John Roberts Retreated to His Island. Supreme Court Critics Found Him.
summary: After decades of potlucks and paddle-boarding on Maine’s midcoast, rising anger and protests have left the Supreme Court’s chief justice more isolated than ever.

title: Inside Binance Founder Changpeng Zhao’s Life After Prison
summary: Changpeng Zhao, jailed in the United States for a financial crime and pardoned by President Trump, is now living a gilded life in the United Arab Emirates.

title: Texas Governor Race Puts Pressure on Andy Beshear and Democratic Governors Association
summary: Allies of Gina Hinojosa want a Democratic group to support her bid for Texas governor — putting pressure on its chairman, Gov. Andy Beshear of Kentucky, who is weighing a run for president.

title: David Ellison’s Vision for CNN: Same C.E.O and No Bari Weiss, for Now.
summary: David Ellison is negotiating to keep CNN’s chief executive, Mark Thompson, in place without oversight from Bari Weiss, the CBS editor in chief, when the networks’ parent companies merge.

title: The New York City Neighborhoods Where It’s Hardest to Build Housing
summary: Some City Council members are losing an informal veto power over new projects in their districts after voters approved a measure aimed at eliminating roadblocks to development.

title: Landlords Release Emails and Texts in Lawsuit Over Mamdani’s Rent Freeze
summary: The communications were revealed as part of a lawsuit challenging the rent freeze on rent-stabilized units in New York City, which went into effect on Thursday.

title: ‘Ready to Blow His Stack’: How Biden Nearly Cut Off Netanyahu Over Gaza
summary: Brett McGurk, who was the top Middle East adviser to President Joseph R. Biden Jr., offered the first inside-the-room account of American efforts to manage the Gaza war.

title: When White People Like Hannah Gann Pretend to Be Black
summary: Rachel Dolezal is now a type.

title: We Are Clueless About What’s Coming
summary: Nick Bostrom is no longer worried about the apocalypse. Now he’s worried about utopia.

title: UK-Iranian Man Arrested in Connection to RAF Fairford Air Base Incident
summary: British police said a 25-year-old British-Iranian dual national was arrested Thursday. British officials have said they believe Iran played a part in planning the incident at R.A.F. Fairford.
